description:

Students work on an independent research problem in a faculty member's lab, typically with a stipend.

sections.heading: Summer Undergraduate Research Programs at Stevens
sections.text: As a student in the Stevens School of Business, the Department of Mechanical Engineering or the Department of Systems Engineering, you will have the opportunity to apply to a part-time summer undergraduate research program led by faculty in your department.

sections.heading: Summer Undergraduate Research Programs at Stevens
sections.text: The Stevens Institute for Artificial Intelligence and the Center for Sustainability also host full-time summer undergraduate research programs that are open to all Stevens undergraduates. Enrolled students can learn more about these programs and their deadlines by visiting the Portal for Undergraduate Research and Fellowships.

sections.heading: External Summer Research Internships
sections.text: If you are interested in applying to an REU, it is useful to start prepping your applications in the fall for early deadlines and be read to submit multiple applications in the first couple of months of the year. Databases that curate and advertise REUs include those hosted by Científico Latino , Pathways to Science , and Princeton Engineering . Other databases are hosted by the National Science Foundation, Department of Energy, the National Institutes of Health and many others.
